decisions.reason: Because this core-adjacent product was mentioned in 2023 but no longer appeared in 2024, its visible market performance seems to have fallen below aspiration levels, so a boundedly rational management would reallocate the released capacity to better-performing display lines or new development.

Although distant from the established offer, the online customer portal supports the firm's stated move toward deeper collaboration and stronger information security, and with current growth, hiring, and investment the firm likely has enough slack to continue testing it despite still-uncertain results.

The packaging display solution clearly exceeds aspiration levels because it is close to the firm's core business and won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, which signals strong acceptance and problem-solving success relative to comparable firms.

This quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display fits the firm's established competencies and was given its own page in 2024, so absent negative evidence management would likely retain it while learning more about demand in a growing market.

The small cardboard counter display is closely aligned with the firm's narrow but specialized display portfolio, and dedicated 2024 presentation suggests performance at least near aspiration, making continuation the likely choice under available slack.

The large freestanding cardboard information display is another close-to-core extension that uses existing design, printing, assembly, and logistics resources efficiently, so management would usually keep it unless clearer signs of underperformance emerged.
